title: Project Serpo book built on Puthoff's spacetime metric engineering

tellings.quote: and one thing that stood out to me was that the whole project Serpo book completely integrates Halputo off spaceimetric engineering.

plain: The book about Project Serpo, a story that began circulating in 2005 about a secret exchange in which Americans supposedly visited an alien world, is said to lean entirely on the ideas of a physicist named Hal Puthoff. His idea, "spacetime metric engineering", holds that space and time themselves could be reshaped to make travel possible. A researcher and quantum computing entrepreneur named Deep Prasad says the book "completely integrates" this physics, which would tie the Serpo tale to serious-sounding science.
